name: Ensenada

routes.outcome: Official state predial page links municipal Ensenada predial services; general state landing evidence only.
Official municipal page lists Subdirección de Catastro and valuation, property-registration and topography departments.
Official municipal notice identifies IMIP's SIGME and says its cadastral layers reach identification of predios and condominium units.
Official municipal notice reports 168,248 predios cartographed in the municipal GIS during 2025.
Search-accessible official page displayed maintenance notice and login prompt; no credentials used and no parcel request attempted.
Direct curl attempt with default TLS verification failed certificate validation; TLS verification was not disabled and no source-specific exception was authorized.
Direct anonymous connection timed out/refused during bounded attempt; no inference of service absence.
